ios.desc:
Math Grid turns the classic Japanese "hyakumasu keisan" (100-square calculation) into a joyful daily habit. One operation in the corner, numbers across the top and side — your child fills every square, beating their own best time.

BUILT FOR AGES 5-7 (AND UP)
- Four operations: addition, subtraction, multiplication and division
- Grid sizes from a friendly 3x3 up to the legendary 100-square
- Auto mode quietly adapts the difficulty: two strong rounds move up a level, a tricky day gently adjusts down - never framed as failure
- Tricky facts quietly reappear in new grids until they are mastered

FRIENDS AND LEADERBOARDS
- Add a friend with a simple friend code (you both accept) and compare your weekly and all-time stars
- See who is online with a friendly presence dot
- Family leaderboard: star champions and fastest fingers

BATTLE A FRIEND
Race a friend on the very same grid:
- Challenge an online friend into a live battle with a single tap
- Online Battle: open a room with a 6-digit code and play in real time. If no one is online, a friendly practice opponent steps in.
- Code Battle: finish a round to get a secret code you can send to a friend so they play the identical grid offline - fastest time wins.

THIS WEEK'S CHALLENGE
Each week features a friendly challenge - a trickier operation or a bigger grid to give a go. Try it and earn extra stars for having a crack. A gentle nudge to explore the harder squares, never a chore, and never any pressure to keep a streak.

MADE FOR FAMILIES
- Up to 6 player profiles, each with their own avatar, colour, progress and streaks
- A practice calendar that glows brighter the more stars you earn
- Parent dashboard (behind a grown-up gate): accuracy charts, level overrides, tricky-facts list

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your child's progress stays on their device. Math Grid has no ads, no third-party analytics, no tracking and no account. The only data that ever leaves the device is for the optional online features: an Online Battle shares just a first name and avatar to run the live match, and the Friends feature shares a first name, avatar, colour, star counts and a simple online/offline status - only with friends you have both accepted. Purchases, external links and sharing sit behind a parental gate.

FREE TO PLAY
3x3 and 4x4 grids, all four operations, Auto mode, battles, friends and 3 profiles are free forever. Math Grid Premium unlocks 5x5 and the full 100-square, manual level picking and premium avatars. The Family plan add
